body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/33388

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1897

## What changed

CPU tensor slices created while expanding bundled multimodal items are now materialized instead of retaining the complete parent storage. This applies to `feature`, `precomputed_embeddings`, and split tensor metadata. Accelerator tensors remain views to avoid adding device copies to IPC/shared-memory paths.

## Reproduction and validation

The issue's exact 512-image fixture reproduced on the prepared base:

- Before: 1,048,576 logical bytes, 543,484,451 pickle bytes, 518.307x amplification.
- After: 1,048,576 logical bytes, 1,375,278 pickle bytes, 1.312x amplification.

Run:

```bash
XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/cache PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/venv/bin/python reports/j-b90e4216b064/reproduce_pickle_amplification.py
XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/cache PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_mm_utils_split.py
XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/cache PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b90e4216b064/venv/bin/python reports/j-b90e4216b064/verify_gpu_slice.py
```

The focused suite passes 9 tests. The assigned AMD Instinct MI355X check independently verifies correct accelerator slice values and confirms accelerator slices continue sharing parent storage.

## Limitations

This directly validates the reported splitting and CPU pickle mechanism without model weights. It is not a full multimodal model or HTTP serving reproduction. The accelerator boundary was checked on ROCm/HIP, not the reporter's CUDA H200 environment. No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
title: Fix multimodal pickle storage amplification
